      3 on:

      7 # Permissions and environment values to be able to update the dependency graph with vcpkg information
      8 # and to enable the writing/uploading of CodeQL scan results
      9 permissions:
     10   contents: write
     11   security-events: write
     12 
     13 env:
     14   GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
     15   VCPKG_FEATURE_FLAGS: dependencygraph
     16 
     17 jobs:
     18   build-windows:
     19     runs-on: 'windows-latest'
     20 
     21     steps:

     23 
     24       - name: Initialize CodeQL
